title: Funding Gaps on the Path to the Digital Decade
description:
Please note that this is not a call for tenders but a publication announcing the Contracting authority’s intention to publish a future negotiated low or middle value procedure (read more here). 

DG CNECT requests the procurement of a Study aimed at estimating investment gaps to reach the 2030 Digital Decade targets. The Study should specifically focus on the analysis of private investment expected in each area of the 2030 Digital Compass and that are in the scope of the Digital Europe Programme, thus complementing an ongoing DG CNECT Study that focuses on public investment expectations.

The present Study should provide evidence of the monetary gaps to achieve the 2030 Digital Decade targets at both the EU and national level and make recommendations as regards the possibilities to cover these, particularly focusing on those areas that could be supported by the Work Programme 2025-2027 of the Digital Europe Programme and by potential future financial products under InvestEU.

In addition, this Study should provide two sets of recommendations. Having in mind the areas for Multi-Country Projects proposed in the Annex to the Digital Decade Policy Programme, it should identify areas for further development of such large-scale projects. Finally, the Study should provide recommendations related to forms of Commission’s funding and alternative forms of funding which may bring sufficient leveraging effect to bridge the monetary gaps.

The results of this Study should be consolidated in a final comprehensive report, representing the main deliverable of the Contract

description: The objective of the activity is to design, manufacture and test a breadboard of a millimetre-wave active array sub-module which demonstrates high integration techniques of critical RF functions. Description: High density millimetre-wave active antenna arrays, which are anticipated for future LEO missions require highly integrated RF functionality to meet the strict periodicity/lattice spacing requirements at such high frequencies. Novel techniques will be necessary to physically integrate the transmit and/or receive MMIC (Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit) with the beamforming functionality whilst managing the RF and DC interconnectivity and thermal heat dissipation issues that will result from such high integration. For such high frequency applications (V-/W-bands), RF electrical interconnections become critical, and loss should be minimised to maintain system efficiency, therefore the use of flip-chip connections or re-distribution layers, should be investigated. In addition, coupling and parasitic inductances need to be minimised to optimise electrical performance and unit to unit consistency. Careful 3D electromagnetic analysis is required to optimise the advanced RF structure performance. The proposed activity aims to develop new and novel manufacturing, packaging and advanced RF integration techniques which provide improved, highly integrated and repeatable performance for millimetre-wave active array applications. The advanced RF integration technique shall be an alternative to PCB (Printed Circuit Board) assembly technologies and could include, but not be limited to techniques such as 3D microelectronics, Fan Out Wafer Level Packaging (FOWLP), flip-chip/hot-via, antenna-inpackage, micromachining, precision additive manufacturing, etc., thereby demonstrating high performance, high integration, and miniaturisation. A breadboard shall be designed, manufactured and tested to demonstrate the electrical, mechanical and thermal aspects. The breadboard shall target a generic mm-wave application which demonstrates the integration of RF functionality in an advanced RF structure, suitable for an active antenna. Novel interconnection/packaging techniques shall only be considered and novel techniques for thermal management shall be proposed. The following tasks are foreseen in the frame of this activity: Requirements review:o Definition of application and review of requirements.o Initial design requirements identification. o Technology trade-off and down-selection. Breadboard preliminary design:o Initial demonstration of solution to meet fundamental requirements. o Preliminary manufacturing process flow definition. Breadboard detailed design and analysis:o Detailed RF and thermal performance analysis. o If deemed necessary, different test vehicles can be designed to evaluate specific performance parameters.o Detailed manufacturing process flow definition. o Definition of test and verification plan. Breadboard manufacturing and test:o Exercise of manufacturing process flows.o Assemble breadboard demonstrator and/or test vehicles.o Test against verification plan. Results analysis and evaluation.

title: Netherlands – Guidance and counselling services – Uitbesteding Vraagwijzertaken
description: De opdracht betreft de uitvoering van de toegang tot het sociaal domein voor de gemeente West Maas en Waal, uitgevoerd onder de naam VraagWijzer. VraagWijzer vormt de toegangspoort voor inwoners met vragen op het gebied van wonen, welzijn, werk, inkomen en zorg. De werkzaamheden omvatten onder meer het verhelderen van ondersteuningsvragen, het verstrekken van informatie en advies, het onderzoeken van hulpvragen, het inzetten van voorliggende voorzieningen en, waar noodzakelijk, het toeleiden naar geïndiceerde ondersteuning. De gemeente West Maas en Waal is een regiegemeente. De opdrachtnemer is verantwoordelijk voor de operationele uitvoering van de toegangstaken. De aanbestedende dienst blijft verantwoordelijk voor beleidsvorming, kaderstelling en contractsturing. De beoogde ingangsdatum van de overeenkomst is 1 januari 2028. De overeenkomst wordt aangegaan voor een initiële periode van vier (4) jaar. De aanbestedende dienst heeft vervolgens de eenzijdige optie om de overeenkomst driemaal met twee (2) jaar te verlengen. De maximale looptijd van de overeenkomst bedraagt daarmee tien (10) jaar. De exacte omvang van de opdracht staat nog niet vast. Nadere informatie over de omvang van de dienstverlening, de financiële kaders en de prijsstelling wordt verstrekt aan de geselecteerde gegadigden in de inschrijvingsfase.
